name: Oil Industry Pension Fund (Iran)
note: Covering fund of the Iranian oil industry ('صندوق بازنشستگی صنعت نفت'); its chairman, Abdol Hossein Bayat, described it in August 2024 as 'a Petroleum Ministry subsidiary' (ANA). Its investment affiliates include Ehdaf Investment and the Taban Farda Petrochemical group (EcoIran, March 2024). The fund group is the largest shareholder of listed PGPIC (38% per Asr-e Iran, September 2026) and took three of five PGPIC board seats at the September 2026 AGM (Petrochemiha, EnergyPress).
